notes: The second isnad (قال ذكرت ذلك لعيسى بن موسى ... نحوه) carries the same saying, so it is a second route, not a variant; نحوه is a wording note.
«فحدثني أنه، سمع غيلان بن أنس» makes Isa and then Ghaylan links (rule 5).
Both chains end on the Prophet's words relayed through the Companion: the Companion is not named in the first route's text beyond «القاسم».
